quirks: Pure-algorithmic format detection (no upstream registry lookup) — _meta.provenance.source is 'algorithmic' and latency is ~1ms. It classifies the FORMAT of the identifier; it does not confirm the company exists.

Detects Swedish org numbers, Finnish business IDs, German HRB numbers, LEIs, DUNS, and 20+ other formats. best_match is the top candidate; all_matches[] lists every format the id could be (may contain multiple entries for ambiguous ids), each with a confidence of high|medium|low.

Single required query param 'id'. To then pull the actual company record, chain the country-specific Strale company-data capability indicated by best_match.country_code (e.g. Swedish Company Data for SE, German Company Data for DE).
usage.guide: Company registration number type/country detector over x402 (keyless, ~$0.054 on Base). GET ?id=<registration number> (e.g. 556703-7485). Read detected to see if it was recognized, best_match{ country, country_code, id_type, confidence } for the top format, and all_matches[] for ambiguous cases. Pure-algorithmic (classifies the identifier format, does not verify the company exists) — use it as a router to pick the right country-specific company-data lookup. Pay the 402 (Base USDC), no API key or sign-in; the 200 body is the result.

name: Strale German Company Data
description: German Handelsregister company lookup via OpenRegister, keyless over x402: resolve by company name, canonical OpenRegister company_id, or HRB/HRA number + court, returning legal name, registration number, court, legal form, status, registered address, directors, share capital, LEI, and incorporation/termination dates for KYB and due diligence. $0.054.

company_name.description: Company name for fuzzy search via OpenRegister /v1/autocomplete/company, e.g. "BMW".

company_id.description: OpenRegister canonical id, e.g. "DE-HRB-F1103-267645". Preferred when known — skips name resolution and consumes one fewer API call.

hrb_number.description: Handelsregister number (e.g. "HRB 2001"). When provided, 'court' is also required — HRB/HRA numbers are per-court and not globally unique.

court.description: Registergericht (German commercial court). Required when providing 'hrb_number'. Example: "Amtsgericht Landsberg a. Lech".

outputSchema.description: { company_name, legal_name, company_id (OpenRegister canonical id e.g. DE-HRB-D2601-233132), registration_number, primary_registration_id, register_type (HRB|HRA|VR|...), court, country_code, legal_form (gmbh|ag|ev|...), status (active|terminated|unknown), is_active, registered_address{ street, postal_code, city, country, co_address }, business_description, industry_codes[], directors[]{ name, role }, capital{ amount, currency } | null, lei | null, incorporated_at, date_incorporated, terminated_at, tier_2_available, tier_2_available_reason, ubo_availability, ubo_availability_reason, _meta{ capability, latency_ms, provenance{ source, source_url, sources[], attribution, acquisition_method }, payment{ method, settlement_id, price_usd } } }

usage.callShape: GET https://api.strale.io/x402/german-company-data?company_name=<name> (fuzzy) OR ?company_id=<OpenRegister id> OR ?hrb_number=<HRB/HRA number>&court=<Registergericht>. Provide one identifier; hrb_number additionally requires court. All params are query string; no body.
usage.outputShape: JSON (synchronous). { company_name, legal_name, company_id, registration_number, register_type, court, country_code, legal_form, status, is_active, registered_address{ street, postal_code, city, country }, business_description, directors[]{ name, role }, capital{ amount, currency }, lei, incorporated_at, terminated_at, tier_2_available, ubo_availability, _meta{ provenance{ source:'OpenRegister', source_url, attribution }, payment{ settlement_id, price_usd } } }.
quirks: Four query identifiers (all optional in the schema, but supply exactly one lookup key): company_name does a fuzzy autocomplete resolve; company_id is the OpenRegister canonical id (e.g. DE-HRB-D2601-233132) and is preferred when known (skips name resolution, one fewer upstream call); hrb_number is the Handelsregister number and REQUIRES court alongside it (HRB/HRA numbers are per-court, not globally unique).
Source is OpenRegister (Handelsregister / Bundesanzeiger); _meta.provenance carries source_url plus signed S3 document URLs for the underlying filings.

directors[] lists legal representatives per filing (name, role e.g. DIRECTOR). ubo_availability is typically 'restricted' — Transparenzregister (UBO) access is limited to obliged entities per GwG §23 after the 2022 CJEU ruling, so beneficial-ownership is not returned.
capital and lei may be null; status is one of active|terminated|unknown.
German-only registry. For UK/US/Swedish/Danish companies use the sibling Strale country company-data capabilities instead.
usage.guide: German Handelsregister (OpenRegister) company lookup over x402 (keyless, ~$0.054 on Base). Simplest path: GET ?company_name=<name> for a fuzzy resolve; for a deterministic pull pass ?company_id=<OpenRegister id like DE-HRB-D2601-233132>, or ?hrb_number=<HRB 2001>&court=<Registergericht>. Read company_name/legal_name, registration_number, register_type, court, legal_form and status/is_active for the identity; registered_address for the seat; directors[] for legal representatives; capital{amount,currency}, lei, and incorporated_at/terminated_at for the corporate profile. Note ubo_availability is 'restricted' (no beneficial-ownership under German law). Pay the 402 (Base USDC), no API key or sign-in; the 200 response is the result.

name: Strale Job Board Search
description: Keyless job-listings search over x402 across Arbetsförmedlingen (Swedish Platsbanken) and Adzuna (multi-country): query by keyword with optional location and remote-only filter, returning each job's title, company, location, salary range, source, posted date, and application URL. $0.216.

query.description: Job search keyword / role, e.g. "software engineer". Required.

remote_only.description: Optional; when true, restrict to remote positions.

outputSchema.description: { query, location (echo of the location filter, null if omitted), jobs[]{ title, company, location, salary_range, url, posted_date, source }, total_results, sources_queried[] (e.g. ['arbetsformedlingen.se']), _meta{ capability, latency_ms, provenance{ source, fetched_at }, payment{ method, settlement_id, price_usd } } }

usage.callShape: GET https://api.strale.io/x402/job-board-search?query=<keyword>&location=<optional>&remote_only=<true|false>. All params are query string; 'query' is required, 'location' and 'remote_only' are optional. No request body.
usage.outputShape: JSON (synchronous). { query, location, jobs[]{ title, company, location, salary_range, url, posted_date, source }, total_results, sources_queried[], _meta{ capability, latency_ms, provenance{ source, fetched_at }, payment{ settlement_id, price_usd } } }.
quirks: Sources are Arbetsförmedlingen (Swedish Platsbanken) and Adzuna (multi-country). In the verified run only arbetsformedlingen.se was queried (sources_queried:['arbetsformedlingen.se']) and results were Sweden-heavy — salary_range values come back in Swedish (e.g. 'Fast månads- vecko- eller timlön'). Use 'location' to steer toward other Adzuna countries.
remote_only is a boolean filter; location is optional. Only 'query' is strictly required — omitting it returns a 402/400.
Each job carries a direct application url (e.g. arbetsformedlingen.se/platsbanken/annonser/<id>) plus posted_date (ISO) and source host.
total_results reflects the number of jobs returned in this response (5 in the verified run), not the total corpus size.
usage.guide: Keyless job-board search over x402 (~$0.216 on Base USDC, no API key or sign-in). GET ?query=<role> with optional &location=<city> and &remote_only=true. The 200 returns jobs[] — read title, company, location, salary_range, posted_date, source, and url (direct application link) — plus total_results and sources_queried[]. Aggregates Arbetsförmedlingen (Swedish Platsbanken) and Adzuna (multi-country); results skew Swedish, so pass location to target other markets. Pay the 402 (Base USDC); the 200 body is the result.

name: Strale LEI Lookup
description: Look up a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) via the GLEIF database by 20-character LEI code or company name, returning the legal name, jurisdiction, legal form, entity + registration status, and legal/headquarters addresses. Keyless pay-per-call over x402.

lei.description: 20-character LEI code to look up, e.g. "549300MLUDYVRQOOXS22". Passed as a query-string parameter.

company_name.description: Company name to search for in GLEIF (alternative to lei), e.g. "Apple Inc". Passed as a query-string parameter. Provide either lei or company_name.

outputSchema.description: { lei, legal_name, jurisdiction, category, legal_form, status, registration_status, initial_registration_date, last_update_date, legal_address{ line1, city, country, postal_code }, headquarters_address{ line1, city, country, postal_code }, _meta{ capability:'lei-lookup', latency_ms, provenance{ source:'gleif.org', fetched_at }, payment{ method:'x402', settlement_id, price_usd } } }

usage.callShape: GET https://api.strale.io/x402/lei-lookup?company_name=<name> (or ?lei=<20-char LEI code>). No body; provide either query param. Pay the 402 (Base USDC); the 200 response is the result.
usage.outputShape: JSON (synchronous). { lei:'HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394', legal_name:'Apple Inc.', jurisdiction:'US-CA', category:'GENERAL', legal_form:'H1UM', status:'ACTIVE', registration_status:'ISSUED', initial_registration_date:'2012-06-06T15:53:00Z', last_update_date:'2026-03-03T16:34:33Z', legal_address:{line1:'C/O C T Corporation System', city:'Glendale', country:'US', postal_code:'91203'}, headquarters_address:{line1:'One Apple Park Way', city:'Cupertino', country:'US', postal_code:'95014'}, _meta{ capability:'lei-lookup', provenance{ source:'gleif.org', fetched_at }, payment{ method:'x402', settlement_id, price_usd } } }.
quirks: Two optional query params 'lei' (20-character LEI code) and 'company_name' (fuzzy name search) — provide one; a name search resolves to the matching GLEIF entity.
Data is fetched live from the GLEIF database (_meta.provenance.source = 'gleif.org') — covers legally registered entities worldwide that hold an LEI.
legal_form is returned as the GLEIF ELF code (e.g. 'H1UM'), not a human-readable label; jurisdiction is an ISO 3166-2 style code (e.g. 'US-CA').
usage.guide: Global GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier lookup over x402 (keyless, ~$0.054 on Base). GET ?company_name=<name> for a fuzzy name search, or ?lei=<20-char LEI code> for a direct lookup. Read lei, legal_name, jurisdiction, legal_form (GLEIF ELF code), status/registration_status, and legal_address/headquarters_address. Pay the 402 (Base USDC), no API key or sign-in; the 200 body is the result. Use this for the globally-unique LEI + registration status of any LEI-holding entity; for national-registry detail use the country-specific Strale company-data capabilities instead.

name: Strale Swedish Company Data
description: Swedish company registry lookup via Bolagsverket's Värdefulla datamängder API, keyless over x402: resolve by Swedish organisationsnummer (org_number) and return legal name, legal form, company type, status/is_active, VAT number, registered address, SNI industry codes, registration date, and any ongoing insolvency/liquidation procedures for KYB and due diligence. $0.054.

org_number.description: Swedish organisationsnummer (10 digits, e.g. "556703-7485"). Required. Passed as a query-string parameter.

outputSchema.description: { company_name, legal_name, org_number, primary_registration_id, vat_number, country_code (SE), company_type (e.g. Aktiebolag), company_type_code (e.g. AB), legal_form, legal_form_code, status (active|deregistered|unknown), is_active (boolean|null), registered_date, date_incorporated, deregistered_date|null, deregistration_reason|null, registered_address{ street, postal_code, city, country, co_address }|null, sni_codes[]{ code, description }, business_description|null, ongoing_procedures[], alternative_names[], tier_2_available, tier_2_available_reason, ubo_availability, ubo_availability_reason, _meta{ capability, latency_ms, provenance{ source:'Bolagsverket Värdefulla datamängder API', source_url, fetched_at, attribution, license, source_note }, payment{ method, settlement_id, price_usd } } }

usage.callShape: GET https://api.strale.io/x402/swedish-company-data?org_number=<organisationsnummer>. Single required query param org_number (Swedish 10-digit org number, e.g. 556703-7485); no body.
usage.outputShape: JSON (synchronous). { company_name:'Spotify AB', legal_name, org_number:'556703-7485', vat_number:'SE556703748501', country_code:'SE', company_type:'Aktiebolag', company_type_code:'AB', legal_form:'Övriga aktiebolag', legal_form_code:'49', status:'active', is_active:true, registered_date:'2006-05-10', date_incorporated, deregistered_date:null, registered_address{ street:'Regeringsgatan 19', postal_code:'11153', city:'STOCKHOLM', country:'Sverige', co_address }, sni_codes[]{ code:'60100', description }, business_description, ongoing_procedures[], alternative_names[], tier_2_available, ubo_availability, _meta{ provenance{ source:'Bolagsverket Värdefulla datamängder API', source_url, attribution:'Källa: Bolagsverket', license:'CC BY 4.0' }, payment{ settlement_id, price_usd } } }.
quirks: Single lookup key: org_number (Swedish organisationsnummer, 10 digits, e.g. 556703-7485). There is no name-search — you must already have the org number. Verified live against Spotify AB (556703-7485).

Source is Bolagsverket's Värdefulla datamängder (Value-added datasets) v1 API; _meta.provenance carries source_url, attribution 'Källa: Bolagsverket' and license CC BY 4.0 (EU Implementing Regulation 2023/138).
Many text values are in Swedish (legal_form 'Övriga aktiebolag', company_type 'Aktiebolag', address country 'Sverige').

status is one of active|deregistered|unknown; deregistered_date and deregistration_reason are populated only for deregistered companies. ongoing_procedures[] lists any active insolvency/liquidation proceedings.

tier_2_available is currently false (legal representatives not yet extracted upstream) and ubo_availability is 'unavailable_no_registry' — beneficial-ownership is not returned. sni_codes[] gives SNI industry classification (code + Swedish description).
Swedish-only registry. For UK/US/German/Danish/Finnish companies use the sibling Strale country company-data capabilities instead.
usage.guide: Swedish company registry lookup (Bolagsverket Värdefulla datamängder) over x402 (keyless, ~$0.054 on Base). Requires the company's Swedish organisationsnummer: GET ?org_number=<10-digit org number, e.g. 556703-7485>. There is no name search. Read company_name/legal_name, org_number, vat_number, company_type/legal_form and status/is_active for identity; registered_address for the seat; sni_codes[] for industry classification; registered_date/date_incorporated and ongoing_procedures[] (insolvency/liquidation) plus deregistered_date for lifecycle. Note tier_2 (legal representatives) and UBO are not available. Pay the 402 (Base USDC), no API key or sign-in; the 200 response is the result.

name: Strale UK Company Data
description: Look up a UK company from Companies House by fuzzy company name or 8-digit company number, returning name, status, business type, jurisdiction, incorporation date, registered address, SIC codes, and legal representatives (officers) with PSC/UBO availability flags. Keyless pay-per-call over x402.

company_name.description: Company name for fuzzy search (e.g. Rolls-Royce, Tesco, BP). Use company_name OR company_number.

company_number.description: Companies House number (8 digits, e.g. 00445790). If you only have a name, use company_name.

outputSchema.description: { company_name, company_number, business_type, jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 / e.g. england-wales), address, registered_address, incorporation_date, date_incorporated, dissolution_date, status, sic_codes[], has_charges, legal_name, legal_form, primary_registration_id, legal_representatives[]{name, role, start_date}, tier_2_available, tier_2_available_reason, ubo_availability, ubo_availability_reason, _meta{capability, latency_ms, provenance{source, fetched_at}, payment} }

usage.callShape: GET https://api.strale.io/x402/uk-company-data?company_name=<name> OR ?company_number=<8-digit number> (query params, no JSON body)
usage.outputShape: JSON inline in the 200. Top-level: company_name, company_number, business_type, jurisdiction, address, registered_address, incorporation_date, date_incorporated, dissolution_date, status, sic_codes[], has_charges, legal_name, legal_form, primary_registration_id, legal_representatives[]{name, role, start_date}, tier_2_available(+reason), ubo_availability(+reason), _meta{capability, latency_ms, provenance{source:'api.company-information.service.gov.uk', fetched_at}, payment{method, settlement_id, price_usd}}.
quirks: Params go in the query string, not a JSON body (GET request).
Provide either company_name (fuzzy search) OR company_number (8-digit Companies House number, e.g. 00445790); company_name resolves to the matching entity.
Source is UK Companies House (api.company-information.service.gov.uk); returns officers under legal_representatives[] and flags ubo_availability (PSC register) rather than the PSC list inline.
Static/dynamic price surfaced in the 402 as $0.0540 USDC; observed charge $0.054001 on Base USDC.
For a non-UK company use the sibling per-country Strale endpoints (us-company-data, german-company-data, swedish-company-data, danish-company-data) — each is a distinct national registry.
usage.guide: UK KYB registry lookup over x402 (keyless, ~$0.054 USDC on Base). To resolve a company from a name, GET https://api.strale.io/x402/uk-company-data?company_name=Tesco; to pull by its Companies House id use ?company_number=00445790. Read company_name/company_number/status/business_type/jurisdiction/incorporation_date/registered_address/sic_codes for the firmographic profile, legal_representatives[] for current officers (name/role/start_date), and has_charges plus ubo_availability for due-diligence. Pay the 402 (Base USDC); result is synchronous inline in the 200, no auth or polling. Verified 2026-08-07 with company_name=Tesco -> TESCO PLC / 00445790, active, incorporated 1947-11-27.

name: Strale US Company Data
description: Look up a US company from SEC EDGAR by CIK number, ticker symbol, or fuzzy company name, returning the legal name, CIK, entity type, SIC code + description, state, registered address, EIN, fiscal year end, ticker, exchange, and status. Keyless pay-per-call over x402.

company.description: CIK number, ticker symbol, or company name to look up, e.g. "AAPL". Passed as a query-string parameter.

outputSchema.description: { company_name, cik, entity_type, sic, sic_description, state, address, ein, fiscal_year_end, ticker, exchange, status, searched_name, match_confidence (e.g. exact), is_exact_match (boolean), _meta{ capability, latency_ms, provenance{ source:'sec.gov/edgar', source_url, acquisition_method, primary_source_reference, fetched_at }, payment{ method, settlement_id, price_usd } } }

usage.callShape: GET https://api.strale.io/x402/us-company-data?company=<CIK|ticker|name>. Single required query param 'company'; no body. Pay the 402 (Base USDC); the 200 response is the result.
usage.outputShape: JSON (synchronous). { company_name:'Apple Inc.', cik:'0000320193', entity_type:'operating', sic:'3571', sic_description:'Electronic Computers', state:'CA', address:'ONE APPLE PARK WAY, CUPERTINO, CA, 95014', ein:'942404110', fiscal_year_end:'0926', ticker:'AAPL', exchange:'Nasdaq', status:'active', searched_name, match_confidence:'exact', is_exact_match:true, _meta{ provenance{ source:'sec.gov/edgar', source_url, primary_source_reference, fetched_at }, payment{ settlement_id, price_usd } } }.
quirks: Single required query param 'company' accepts three input forms: a CIK number, a ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL), or a fuzzy company name. match_confidence / is_exact_match indicate how well the name resolved.
Data is fetched live from SEC EDGAR (_meta.provenance.source = 'sec.gov/edgar', acquisition_method 'direct_api') — US-registered filers only. cik is zero-padded to 10 digits.

The 402 outputSchema advertises vat_number and jurisdiction fields (EU VAT auto-derivation), but the paid 200 for a US filer returned SEC-specific fields (ein, ticker, exchange, sic_description) instead; treat the extra fields as optional/best-effort.
usage.guide: US company registry lookup over x402 (keyless, ~$0.054 on Base), sourced live from SEC EDGAR. GET ?company=<CIK|ticker|company name> (e.g. company=AAPL). Read company_name, cik, sic/sic_description, state, address, ein, ticker, exchange, and status; match_confidence/is_exact_match tell you how the name resolved. Pay the 402 (Base USDC), no API key or sign-in; the 200 body is the result. For non-US filers use the country-specific Strale company-data capability instead.
